name: Phone line
kid: The old copper phone line carries the parcel as lots of tiny tones, high above the sounds of a phone call.
nerd: VDSL2: DMT tones on one copper pair, up to 17 MHz, from a cabinet a few hundred metres away. In 2010 most DSL homes still had ADSL2+ from the exchange (up to about 20 Mbit/s); this line could carry more, but its plan is 20/2 Mbit/s.
